text: Marlowe Finch, contest judge! Got a big one for me?
Biggest single fish wins, every two days. Simple. Fair. Fishy.
Mind my scales, they're calibrated. Mostly.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Up with the gulls, I see.
Swordfish round Stormbreak. Catfish in the bayou. Parrotfish on the reefs. Eels anywhere at night.
And out past the charts, far from any land, the Golden Marlin. If you've the skill.
More skill, bigger fish. Simple as that.
Fish at night for eels and ghostfins. Fish in the rain because the fish don't mind it.
